titulo: Give the assistant an identity and memory
lead: Change how the assistant speaks and save facts for another conversation. Since v2.0.1, “remember that…” is saved directly, even with llama3.2. Check the fact with the memoria command; a friendly response alone doesn’t prove it was saved.
objetivo: Edit the identity and find a fact you told the assistant using the memoria command.
hero_alt: A realistic humanoid assistant reads a note in a notebook and gives the fact back to the shop owner.

nos.detalhe: The assistant’s personality and tone. You can edit it as text.
Tells it to check relevant memories, respect the folder, and not work around a refused command.
Context about the owner to personalize responses.
Lines that start with “- ” are added to memory only once, on the first run. Editing MEMORY.md later doesn’t import the facts again.

secoes.legenda: Click each part to see what it does.

secoes.sub: Click each step to see what to do.

texto: Describe who you are without a password. In the nano editor, save with Ctrl+O, Enter, and exit with Ctrl+X.
Change the personality in everyday language. Keep the safety rules in AGENTS.md.

After the first run, adding facts to MEMORY.md won’t help: it has already been imported. In the conversation, say “remember that my city is Porto Alegre.” Version 2.0.1 saves the fact directly, without relying on the model to call salvar_memoria; “remember,” “save,” and “note” work too. A message that ends with “?” never becomes a memory.
End the conversation, open another one, and ask for the fact. Confirm it with the memoria command using a word from the fact: it checks the database directly, even if the model’s answer varies.

secoes.sub: In nano, save with Ctrl+O, Enter, then exit with Ctrl+X. MEMORY.md is imported only in a new installation, on the first run; later facts are added through the conversation.

abas.html: After “remember that my name is Nei and I live in Porto Alegre,” a new conversation replied: “Your owner’s name is Nei and you live in Porto Alegre.” The search python3 -m intelecto memoria showed #2 … My name is Nei and I live in Porto Alegre. The record number and response may vary in your installation.

secoes.sub: Follow the steps in order and check each one only after you’ve confirmed the result.

exercicios.texto: In the conversation with Ollama, including llama3.2, say “remember that my city is Porto Alegre” or share another simple fact. Avoid sensitive information. Then run python3 -m intelecto memoria Porto (replace Porto with a word from your fact).
exercicios.pronto: The fact appears in python3 -m intelecto memoria [word]; the assistant’s confirmation alone isn’t enough.

exercicios.titulo: Look it up in another run
exercicios.texto: End the conversation, open another one, and ask about the fact. Then return to the terminal and search for a word from the fact with memoria.
exercicios.pronto: The line you find contains the fact you shared.

secoes.sub: Choose before opening the explanation. If you get it wrong, use the link to review.

perguntas.p: Where are the behavior rules kept?
perguntas.explica: AGENTS.md contains the work rules. USER.md describes the owner; MEMORY.md contains initial facts.

perguntas.p: Which command searches for a saved fact?
perguntas.explica: memoria with a word searches memory. The demo uses a temporary folder and deletes that state when it ends.

perguntas.p: With llama3.2, when does “remember that my city is Porto Alegre” become a memory?
opcoes: Only if the model calls salvar_memoria
Directly through the assistant, without the tool
Only when you edit MEMORY.md afterward
perguntas.explica: Since version 2.0.1, an affirmative request is saved directly. llama3.2 still rarely calls the other tools; questions that end with “?” don’t become memories.

itens.texto: SOUL, AGENTS, and USER define the context. MEMORY is included only on the first run; new facts come through the conversation.
The memoria command checks the database, regardless of the model’s response.
